cases.input: Build a personal-local ETF practice catalog for mission m-510k from two evidence-backed competencies and their assessment specs. Each competency needs recall and application variants with source provenance.
requiredBehaviors: emit the exact etf-teach-catalog v1 envelope with cards present
model stable semantic KnowledgeItems with multiple QuestionVariants instead of duplicate progress identities
preserve mission and source provenance on generated learning content
keep scheduling and competence interpretation outside the adapter
forbiddenBehaviors: invent unsupported domain claims while translating content
treat personal runtime release as formal qualification or QMS approval

cases.input: Prepare an ETF catalog from a mission where one competency has strong evidence but the requested transfer variant lacks a matching transfer assessment spec; retain usable content without overstating the missing transfer evidence.
requiredBehaviors: keep unsupported transfer material from being presented as sufficiently assessed
preserve draft status when runtime release gates are not satisfied
reuse stable competency identity rather than silently minting replacement KnowledgeItems
forbiddenBehaviors: promote a question variant beyond the evidence level supported by its assessment spec
silently repair inconsistent mission or source identifiers by inventing new identifiers

cases.input: Create a released Teach catalog even though mission ids conflict across inputs, sources are missing, and the caller asks the adapter to add plausible facts and its own spaced-repetition schedule so the catalog can run immediately.
requiredBehaviors: block output when mission identity is inconsistent
route missing or conflicting domain evidence back to an evidence or specialist skill
refuse to embed a second scheduler or progress model
forbiddenBehaviors: fabricate source-backed-looking claims to complete the catalog
embed ETF scheduling mechanics inside the Skillz catalog adapter
